title: Trigonometry | Height and Distance - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Height and Distance is a branch of trigonometry used to find the height, distance, or position of objects by using angles and trigonometric ratios like sine, cosine, and tangent. It helps us measure things that are difficult to measure directly, such as the height of a building, the distance of a ship from the shore, or the elevation of a mountain.

Foundations

Master the core trigonometry concepts that form the base for understanding and solving Heights & Distances problems.

  • Introduction to Trigonometry
  • Sin, Cos, Tan Values
  • Pythagoras Theorem
  • Trigonometry Table
  • Trick to Remember Trigonometric Table
  • Trigonometric Ratios of Specific Angles
  • Trigonometry Formulas
  • Trigonometric Identities

Core Concepts

Learn the key concepts of Heights & Distances that are essential for solving angle-based measurement problems.

  • Introduction to Height and Distance
  • Angle of Elevation
  • Angle of Depression

Applications of Trigonometry

Explore how trigonometry is applied in real-world fields such as navigation, architecture, aviation, engineering, and surveying.

  • Applications of Trigonometry in Real Life
  • Real Life Applications of Trigonometric Functions
